notes: §1985:XVI.3.3.4 SRL2.1: a SORT in an independent segment names procedures "Totally within non-independent segments, or" wholly within its own independent segment. Segmentation.CheckProcedures takes the SORT's segment from ctx.CurrentSection and RangeAllowed admits all-fixed or own-segment procedures only (COBOL6877 otherwise), per procedure from SortBinder.SortBindFile/CheckSegmentation at 85; the witness SORT in 60 with INPUT 10 THRU 70 is refused. Probes at --std 85 (work-rd-11): each procedure is checked on its own at its phrase (SortBinder.CheckSegmentation): s01 SORT in segment 0 with INPUT in 60 and OUTPUT in 70 accepted and ran (A B DONE), s02 SORT in 60 with INPUT in 60 and OUTPUT in fixed 20 ran (A B DONE), s03 SORT in 60 USING F1 OUTPUT in 70 refused COBOL6877, s07 SORT USING/GIVING (sequential files, no procedures) in 60 ran (A); c edition arm: a segment-number at 2002/2014/2023 is COBOL0902 and --permissive does not ask the rule (e01); a, d, f do not reach a procedure-placement rule. The procedures are the NAMED ones (docs/CONFORMANCE.md 3.8).
